count_definition: Selected reconstructed events with the existing 105–160 GeV mass selection; pilots excluded; Pythia scale variants are correlated.
failure: The same Pythia seed aborted with heap corruption in three configurations. Herwig completed all 200 files. The root cause remains under investigation.
diagnostic: A bounded, isolated replay is running under a debugger and memory-error diagnostics. Production physics inputs and successful outputs are unchanged.
eta: No reliable completion estimate until the failure is resolved and recovery passes validation.
